messages:
jade: Postmortem posted for yesterday's DNS/SNI flapping during the regional LB rollout. Summary: stale DNS cache + concurrent SNI swap led to intermittent TLS handshake failures and retry storms. Need concrete follow-ups and owners. See notes: PN-5030 and PN-5032 in doc.
owen: I can take the DNS side. Will own PN-5040 (ttl-sync-and-rollout). Immediate plan: bump negative cache TTL and add a staged refresh. ETA: config PR in 24h, rollout in 48h.
carmen: I'll handle SNI rotation locking (PN-5041). Hypothesis: rotation isn't atomic across nodes causing mixed SNI responses. Short-term mitigation: fenced rotation with leader write. Long-term: add versioned SNI metadata in KV. Target spike-free rollout in 2 weeks.
tariq: Monitoring/alerts owner here. PN-5042. Adding per-node TLS-failure-rate, DNS-nxdomain-rate, and cross-region retry spikes. Will add synthetic checks that assert handshake success + SNI correctness. Draft alert rules in #eng-sre.
jade: Good. Please paste ticket numbers and short runbooks here so I can include in the exec summary. Also confirm if any customer-facing mitigations needed.
owen: PN-5040 3 dns-quick: comments: 1) bump resolver negative_ttl to 10s, 2) add probe sweep after rollout for 15min, 3) add low-risk canary in ap-southeast-1.
carmen: PN-5041 3 sni-lock: immediate: implement rotation lock using kv->rotate_in_progress flag, fallback to previous cert if lock fails. Longer: atomic rotate API + leader election to prevent split-brain.
tariq: PN-5042 3 alerts: fire pager if TLS-handshake-failures > 3% for 5m or cross-region retry ratio > 7%. Runbook: rollback rotation, clear cache, route to stable pool.
jade: Customer note: short-term we'll enable TTL bump and hold further rollouts until metrics stable. No widespread customer impact observed but high retry rates for some EU customers. I'll draft a short customer-facing status note.
owen: Config snippet I'll submit: ```yaml
resolver:
  negative_ttl: 10  # temp bump to reduce stale NX responses
  cache_clean_interval: 30s
```

carmen: Locking patch sample: ```go
func rotateCert(cluster string) error {
  if !acquireLock("sni-rotate") { return fmt.Errorf("rotation in progress") }
  defer releaseLock("sni-rotate")
  // rotate certs atomically
}
```

tariq: Ops notes: during rollout, block concurrent gateway deployments for 1h windows. ops-bot, can you set a deploy freeze when we run the canary?
ops-bot: @tariq Yes 3 setting deploy-freeze for the canary window and will ping release-war-room. Follow-up sync created for 2003013600.
jade: Owners recap for exec: Owen -> PN-5040 (DNS TTL + canary) ETA PR 24h, Carmen -> PN-5041 (SNI rotation lock) ETA prototype 72h, Tariq -> PN-5042 (alerts + probes) ETA 24h, Ops -> freeze + canary validation. I'll publish the action tracker after you paste links to the tickets.
owen: Added notes and will link PN-5040 in the postmortem doc. Also adding a quick integration test that simulates concurrent rotations.
carmen: Will post PN-5041 with design and quick rollback plan. Plan to add a feature flag for staged enable.
tariq: I'll populate PN-5042 with dashboards and the runbook. Also adding a synthetic that asserts SNI header matches expected cert id.
ops-bot: Reminder: 24h status ping scheduled (2003013600) with [owen, carmen, tariq, jade].
jade: Thanks team. Keep updates brief in the tickets every 12-24h. If you hit a blocker tag me directly. :thumbsup:
